scope: Twelve consecutive definition-to-first-call cycles on one physical-MEGA65 session, correlated with read-only counters after every cycle. This is diagnostic evidence, not a G5 case receipt or a performance PASS.

method.forms: constant-size fresh defun followed by its first call; no user form between cycles
method.counter_method: ELF-resolved JTAG memsave while the REPL was idle after each timed cycle
method.instrumentation_limit: Counter reads occur between cycles and may alter frame phase. The timed interval is entirely on-device and excludes every counter read.

analysis.gc_delta_observation: Five cycles with two additional GC runs average 95.6 frames; six cycles with three additional GC runs average 96.833 frames. The sample is diagnostic and does not establish causality.
analysis.directory_observation: Directory grows by eight at cycles 3 and 11, which measure 95 and 98 frames respectively; a directory-bound step is not supported.
analysis.session_growth_observation: Symbols grow by one, namepool by seven bytes and persistent EXT by nine bytes every cycle, but elapsed time does not grow monotonically. The fitted slope interval includes zero.
analysis.outlier_observation: The earlier 110-frame value did not recur in this twelve-cycle series and remains unexplained; it may not be used as a safety or performance claim.

classification.performance_bar: not-passed; dated C2/1.2 limitation remains in force
classification.bounded_next_step: One optimization probe may target the measured constant reload/commit cost. It must preserve validation semantics, remain within all frozen capacity dimensions, and rerun this full curve; no threshold repin follows from this receipt.
